```yaml
name: ESLint Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run ESLint
      run: npm run eslint -- .

    - name: Upload ESLint report as artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: eslint-report
        path: .eslintrc.json

  dispatch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Dispatch ESLint check
      uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
      with:
        workflow: "ESLint Check"
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        inputs: '{"ref": "${{ github.ref }}", "repo": "${{ github.repository }}" }'
```
